header_data.name: AUDIO_Z80_SEQUENCE_HEADER_DATA
header_data.record_format: track_count byte followed by track_count little-endian 16-bit offsets

streams.decoder: Encoded operand groups are consumed before each event. Z80 handlers consume arguments as follows: 0x61, 0x62, 0x64, 0x66-0x6B, and 0x6E consume one; 0x6C, 0x6F, and 0x70 consume two; 0x71 and 0x72 consume three and two respectively.

boundary_check: All 297 table-referenced streams terminate at 0x60 without overlap. Sorted stream ranges are adjacent and form one contiguous payload whose final byte is immediately before AUDIO_Z80_SAMPLE_DESCRIPTOR_TABLE at 0x001C73CB.
